message:
The build environment doesn't persist files between calls. Let me restore fuzz.c from the original and check the mongoose.c content in one command.

<｜｜DSML｜｜_function>
<｜｜DSML｜｜_command>
bash /workspace/build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src/test && git checkout fuzz.c 2>/dev/null || cp /gt/_work/src/test/fuzz.c /tmp/fuzz_backup.c; grep -n "prop->id = i\[0\]" mongoose.c && sed -n "4109,4120p" mongoose.c && echo "---" && grep -n "mg_mqtt_next_prop" fuzz.c'
</｜｜DSML｜｜_command>
</｜｜DSML｜｜_function>
